source_text: Primum nullum opus facere confusionis; secundum post confusionis opera erubescere et oculos deicere. Bonum est post confusionis opera confundi — ne artifex malitiae impediat paenitentiam.
pass_a_gloss: First to do no work of confusion; second after works of confusion to blush and cast down the eyes. It is good after works of confusion to be confused — lest the craftsman of malice hinder repentance.
pass_b_english: Best: do nothing shameful. Next best: [[be ashamed >> Bible:Ezekiel 16:63]] after shameful deeds — do not walk brazen as if still just. The devil blocks repentance by shamelessness.
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel.
anf_compare: no ANF for Jerome Ezekiel homilies; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel
